attendees[].description: Normalized attendance list, replacing the per-person columns and the per-person absence columns of the wide record.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the meeting, derived from its start/finish times.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source submission, shelf-qualified `<shelf>:<source id>`.

financial_period.description: The period the talk falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

issues_raised.description: Issues or hazards raised at the meeting.

narrative.description: The Q&A prose composed once at ingress and stored as `Fact.content`.

occurred_at.description: Submission date/time; the event time and the retention clock.

occurred_on.description: Date-only form date captured by the reader's date-field detection (source key `diary_date`).

project.description: Project the talk was held on.

signature_ref.description: Reference to a signature captured on the form.

source_refs.description: Originating system identifiers (`form_id`, `diary_id`, raw `project_id`/`worker_id`) kept for reconciliation instead of freezing vendor column names into the contract.

tenant_answers.description: The remaining tenant form-template columns, held verbatim. Tenant content, never part of the standard contract, never named outside the tenant.

title.description: Title of the form/record that produced the fact (observed source key `form_title`), stamped by the pattern sweep.

worker.description: Worker the talk attaches to at form level (the WORKER anchor).
